:::{#thm-bernoulli-mle}
#### Maximum likelihood estimate of a binary sample

If $\Outvar_\iobs \simind \Ber(\prob)$ for $\iobs = 1, \dots, n$ and the observed [sample mean](exploratory-descriptive.qmd#def-sample-mean) satisfies $\outbar \in (0, 1)$,
the [maximum likelihood estimate](#def-mle) of $\prob$ is the sample mean:

$$\hprob_{\text{ML}} = \outbar$$

:::

::: proof

This is the solution to @exr-bernoulli-mle, worked in @sol-bernoulli-mle.
It builds on @thm-bernoulli-score-equation and @thm-bernoulli-hessian-nd.

:::
